notes: Port pause menu (desktop_pause_menu.cpp). START or Back opens it with RESUME chosen and EXIT beside it; left/right or the mouse moves between them and A or a click takes one. EXIT asks NO / YES first, on NO. B, START, Back or a right click resumes (in the question, answers NO). The buttons are the result screen's EXIT pill (result_tex: plain and lit) drawn width units wide: cap texels at each end as they are, the middle stretched from fill_column, the label in the game font centred over it in text_colour (lit_text_colour when chosen). title and help are centred on their x. In a live RUMBLING the full pre-boss roster appears between the title and buttons, with skulls for eliminated opponents; up/down pages through longer rosters. Roster colours follow ordinary, leader, champion and reserve status. All roster layout and skull pixels are editable below.
